name: DuelBits
rootCause: The hot wallet of the crypto gambling platform Duelbits was attacked, resulting in a loss of approximately $4.6 million.

descriptions.text: The hot wallet of the crypto gambling platform Duelbits was attacked, resulting in a loss of approximately $4.6 million.

Duelbits, a centralized crypto casino, lost approximately $4.6 million on February 13, 2024, after an attacker compromised its operational hot wallet credentials. Assets were withdrawn from wallets on both Ethereum and BNB Chain and bridged to attacker-controlled accounts. The exact method of compromise is unresolved, and no direct chain transaction references are publicly confirmed. Operational hot wallet credentials were compromised, enabling unauthorized withdrawals on Ethereum and BNB Chain. The precise cause,whether malware, insider action, or leaked keys,remains publicly unresolved.
